column1: # STEPS.tsv -- THE DESIGN-PLAN tabling-one-engine STEP TABLE (the cio, 2026-11-10, CIO-104 amended by CIO-105; skill prolog-tabling reference section 5; staged on origin by the cfo 2026-11-11, CIO-126).

# harness/scripts/test_design_tabling_one_engine_steps.sh reads it: --list prints it; --step N grades the step's witnesses, each an ENTRY of the Prolog master corpus/tests/prolog/ALL.pl in the family one_engine (CIO-24: a witness is a container entry), in mode 3 and mode 4 through corpus_suite_harness.py run --partition entry:NAME, the answer cut from swipl 9.0.4 by util_add_ladder_witness.py; then the probe tokens.

# A witness prints one line each time a rule body runs, tagged with its phase; the law is the NUMBER of body runs per phase, not their order: oe1 to oe7 sort their own output (the clause oe_sorted/1 in the entry), so the compare is exact.

# probe tokens: swi=<file>:<N> (results.tsv: the latest mode-3 PASS count of that file of the swi suite is at least N; read, never run) | fam=<family>:<N> (the same for an XsbTests family) | nosym=<file>:<name,name,...> (none of the names occurs in the file) | maxlines=<file>:<N> | none.
# THE STEPS ARE A LINE, never two open at once (the cto's caution: 2, 3 and 4 all edit tabling.pl): 1 then 2 then 3 then 4.
